steps.instruction: On this first type of recruitment plot each read is displayed as a dot (scatter plot). a

steps.title: For each marker and each virome,...
steps.instruction: For each marker and each virome, a tree gallery is displayed. Leaves are colored according to the taxonomy, except for metagenomic sequences highlighted in red and bold. a

steps.instruction: Trees can be displayed in circular or linear form. a

steps.instruction: Information is displayed on each leaf when clicked. a

steps.title: A package containing all sequences used...
steps.instruction: A package containing all sequences used in the trees as well as the alignments and trees as text and picture is available to download. a

steps.title: The fullscreen view is especially useful...
steps.instruction: The fullscreen view is especially useful when dealing with large trees.

steps.title: Trees can be computed from multiple...
steps.instruction: Trees can be computed from multiple viromes if the trees with the same marker were computed for each dataset. a

steps.title: Leaves are then colored according to...
steps.instruction: Leaves are then colored according to the virome, reference sequences being left gray. a

steps.title: Taxonomy of reference sequences is still...
steps.instruction: Taxonomy of reference sequences is still indicated next to the leaf name. a

steps.title: Three clustering thresholds are available that...
steps.instruction: Three clustering thresholds are available that can be used with whole virome or normalized sub-samples (50,000 sequences, 100bp) a

steps.title: Curve colors are associate with the virome biome
steps.instruction: Curve colors are associate with the virome biome. a

steps.title: A range of dots on each...

steps.title: The matrix used to plot the...
steps.instruction: The matrix used to plot the curve is available to download via this link. a

steps.title: Comparisons can be based on k-mer...
steps.instruction: Comparisons can be based on k-mer frequencies bias or tBLASTx reads similarities. a

steps.instruction: An MDS can be computed to display the different viromes. a

steps.instruction: Same comparison can be displayed through a clustering tree. a

steps.title: They are automatically loaded when a...
steps.instruction: They are automatically loaded when a project of type "contigs" is selected. a

steps.title: Three types of taxonomic composition are...
steps.instruction: Three types of taxonomic composition are computed for contigs: Predicted gene best Blast hit Contig best BLAST hit Contig lowest common ancestor a

steps.title: Contigs to be displayed can be...
steps.instruction: Contigs to be displayed can be filtered based on their name, affiliation or size. a

steps.title: Predicted genes are indicated along the...
steps.instruction: Predicted genes are indicated along the contig in red (unaffiliated), green (affiliated) and orange (similarity to a function domain only). a

steps.title: Sequences of each OFR are displayed when clicked
steps.instruction: Sequences of each OFR are displayed when clicked. a

steps.title: The corresponding genbank file, contig sequence,...
steps.instruction: The corresponding genbank file, contig sequence, and predicted ORFs sequences are available to download. a

steps.title: All contigs with (at least) an...
steps.instruction: All contigs with (at least) an ORF similar to the current contig are listed in this 'Related contigs' table. a

steps.title: These contigs can then be selected to generate a network
steps.instruction: These contigs can then be selected to generate a network. a Network generation can take some time.

steps.title: The default network displays contigs as...
steps.instruction: The default network displays contigs as gray nodes, and reference genomes as red nodes. a

steps.title: Color and type of layout are fully customizable
steps.instruction: Color and type of layout are fully customizable. a

steps.title: This network is made with Cytoscape...
steps.instruction: This network is made with Cytoscape web, and downloadable as a plot or a network file ready to be imported in Cytoscape.

steps.title: A click on a network element...
steps.instruction: A click on a network element will display information about the contig, the reference genome, or the BLAST hit. a

steps.title: Finally, a multiple map viewer is...
steps.instruction: Finally, a multiple map viewer is available for nodes selected on network. a

steps.title: The order of sequences can be modified with a drag-and-drop
steps.instruction: The order of sequences can be modified with a drag-and-drop. Each sequence can also be reverse-complemented. a

steps.title: A click on a gene will display information about it
steps.instruction: A click on a gene will display information about it. a

steps.instruction: Multiple viromes can be added to the same network / map gallery. a Again, the first loading step an be a bit long.
